Application Data.NAME: Springfield Shopping Plaza
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Springfield Shopping Plaza is a multi-tenant shopping center featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, restaurants, and service providers. Our operations include the management and leasing of commercial spaces, maintenance of common areas, and promoting community events to enhance customer engagement. We prioritize tenant satisfaction and strive to create a vibrant shopping environment that attracts a wide range of visitors.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a severe storm caused roof damage resulting in water intrusion. The estimated repair cost was $2,500. The claim was filed, and the status is closed with the payment received.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Fence perimeter with security watchperson during operating hours.
